overview_description.description: Stillwind develops software that supports autonomous electrical engineering by applying artificial intelligence to hardware design tasks. The company focuses on AI-powered tools for electrical engineers and printed circuit board designers. Its flagship product, Stillwind Search, is a semantic search engine that turns natural language queries into detailed technical specifications for electronic components. The platform matches these specifications against a proprietary database containing millions of parts to streamline component selection. Stillwind targets engineering teams that design complex electronic systems and seek to reduce manual part lookup. Its tools are used during component evaluation, schematic design, and iterative prototyping workflows. By embedding AI into core engineering processes, Stillwind aims to accelerate hardware development and reduce friction in electronic design workflows.
